prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1380; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. Initial examination revealed effusion and tenderness along the medial joint line, with flexion limited to approximately 110 degrees. Imaging was ordered to rule out fracture, and no acute bony abnormality was identified; findings were consistent with a soft tissue injury including a suspected medial meniscal strain.

Over the course of twelve supervised visits, the patient completed a structured program of physical therapy focused on quadriceps strengthening, gait retraining, and progressive range-of-motion exercises. Anti-inflammatory medication and activity modification were used for pain control, with ice and compression applied during the early phase. By the final visit, effusion had resolved, flexion had improved to near full range, and the patient reported pain reduced from moderate at intake to occasional mild discomfort with prolonged standing or stair descent.

Residual symptoms are expected to continue improving with a home exercise program. The patient has been counseled on activity progression and advised to return if mechanical symptoms such as locking or giving way develop. Discharge from active care is recommended at this time.
